changes.js/realtime-view.js: Added renderFilterBar(), setFilter(), renderFiltered(), escapeHtml() functions. Filter state preserved through DataFusion updates and language changes. Fixed pre-existing getStatus bug.

l3_init.notes: Filter bar renders after DataFusion data loaded

l4_usability.notes: Click operator → filtered cards shown. Click All → all cards restored. 67 JR-East, 10 TokyoMetro, 15 Seibu, 8 Keio verified.

l5_interaction.notes: Filter buttons toggle active state. Modal still opens on card click. Language switch preserves filter state.

l6_adaptation.notes: Mobile: 22 filter buttons, 149 cards, no h-scroll. Min-height 44px touch targets.

l7_consistency.notes: Uses same i18n system (filter.all key). Same CSS variables. Same modal pattern.

l8_industry.notes: Operator filter tabs match Yahoo!/Jorudan pattern. All button first, then operators alphabetically.

l9_product.notes: 156 lines now easily filterable by 21 operators. User can quickly find specific line.
